[Suggested upload date: 2026-06-01]

CHANGE ORDER NO. 1

Change Order No. 1 to Statement of Work SOW-001, issued under the Master
Service Agreement between Solstice Retail Group, Inc. and Cobalt Digital
Solutions, LLC dated 2 March 2026.

Dated: 18 May 2026

1. BACKGROUND. Following strong early results from the initial pilot scope
defined in SOW-001, Solstice Retail Group, Inc. has requested an expansion
of the pilot deployment prior to full rollout.

2. CHANGES TO SOW-001.
(a) Deliverable D2 is expanded from five (5) to eight (8) stores
("Deliverable D2a").
(b) Deliverable D3 (full rollout, forty stores) is extended from Week 22 to
Week 24 to accommodate the expanded pilot evaluation period.
(c) The fixed fee under SOW-001 is increased by USD 45,000 to cover the
expanded pilot scope, payable upon D2a acceptance.

3. NO OTHER CHANGES. All other terms of SOW-001 remain unchanged. This
Change Order applies solely to SOW-001 and does not modify SOW-002 or any
other Statement of Work issued under the Agreement.

For SOLSTICE RETAIL GROUP, INC.          For COBALT DIGITAL SOLUTIONS, LLC
Name: J. Alvarez                          Name: R. Chen
Title: Project Manager                    Title: Delivery Lead
